name: Titano Finance
rootCause: On February 14, the Titano Finance project on the BSC chain was attacked. The attackers made a total of 4,828.7 BNB, or about $190w. According to the official Titano Finance investigation, “The problem arose when we trusted a contractor to deploy the PLAY contract. Although ownership was transferred back to us after deployment, it was the same deployer wallet that allowed two days ago from our PLAY Hacking that steals all Titano in the protocol.”

descriptions.text: On February 14, the Titano Finance project on the BSC chain was attacked. The attackers made a total of 4,828.7 BNB, or about $190w. According to the official Titano Finance investigation, “The problem arose when we trusted a contractor to deploy the PLAY contract. Although ownership was transferred back to us after deployment, it was the same deployer wallet that allowed two days ago from our PLAY Hacking that steals all Titano in the protocol.”

Titano Finance’s PLAY contract on BNB Chain was drained on 2022-02-14 after an owner-controlled PrizeStrategy path minted 32,000,000 TicketTitano and redeemed it for Titano, with about 4,828 BNB, roughly $1.9 million, moved out through the exploiter wallet. The PLAY contract retained owner-controlled PrizeStrategy authority after deployment, which allowed the caller to mint TicketTitano and redeem it against the prize pool through withdrawInstantlyFrom().
